pages.text: A ball of generic matter, useful as ammunition for a $(l:items_blocks_machines/matter_cannon)Matter Cannon$(/l) or for producing $(l:items_blocks_machines/paintballs)paintballs$(/l).$(br2)Made with 256 items or buckets in a $(l:items_blocks_machines/condenser)Matter Condenser$(/l) in matter ball mode.
